params.name: REAPER 2076
params.note: CONCEPT, generated by scripts/shapes/concepts/reaper-2076.mjs (edit that, not this). The Reaper fifty years on: still the gun with a plane round it. A seven-barrel rotary cannon in the open under a chined nose, clamped, with a ribbed and slotted breech housing, gas diverters and a feed chute back to a drum fairing with a lit rounds strip; a frameless gold-tinted bubble on an armoured tub bolted down both flanks; a targeting turret, a refuelling receptacle, aperture windows; aft of the cockpit a broad flat engine deck with both turbofans buried in it, each breathing through a dorsal intake under a raked visor and blowing out of a flat slot nozzle over a beavertail; two fins canted hard out on the deck edges over a swept tailplane; a swept wing with raked tips, strakes, and the gear standing half out of leading-edge pods; a missile, a glide bomb and a targeting pod on pylons; light lines on the chines, the deck edges, the intakes and every leading edge. A variant of the gunship mesh, worn as the REAPER 2076 factory edition.

parts.name: fuselage
parts.note: The shell. Glass, frames, the armour, the gun trough and the seams are separate parts laid a hair proud of it.
